task.description: git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0720-20260919 first, then git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex config/dev.exs config/test.exs to see the actual change. This is a required gate: the diff touches lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex, the pre-authentication /api/tenant-config route whose moduledoc names an explicit anti-oracle/never-error security rule (INV-5-adjacent) -- confirm the change does not weaken that rule for the resolve_realm/2 per-tenant lookup path (it should not touch that path at all; verify). Independently verify the new default_idp_base_url!/0 raise path cannot leak any tenant-identifying or credential information in its error message/log (it should only ever name the resolution-chain failure itself, never any request-specific data). Verify the new @allow_localhost_idp_fallback? compile-time flag cannot be set true in a real deployment by an attacker or by accident (confirm config/prod.exs and config/runtime.exs are untouched and do not set it, so it defaults false in any prod/runtime-configured environment) per security-invariants.md's relevant invariants.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict stated per-invariant (APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE with PASS/FAIL) against security-invariants.md's INV-1..INV-8, not a general impression
Confirms resolve_realm/2's per-tenant lookup branch and its never-error/anti-oracle behavior are untouched by this diff
Confirms the raise path in default_idp_base_url!/0 leaks no tenant/credential data
Confirms config/prod.exs and config/runtime.exs are untouched and the new flag defaults false there
